If an AI system acts autonomously, who is responsible for its actions?

An agent can plan, use tools, access information, and perform actions without human intervention at every step.

But operational autonomy cannot create a responsibility gap.

A core thesis of Agentic AI:

Technical autonomy does not create legal autonomy.

🌐 https://www.nicfab.eu/en/pages/book-agentic-ai/ 

#AgenticAI #AIGovernance #Accountability
